shell_channel.hypothesis: A fixed-ratio ultraviolet shell E_N has d_N=Theta(N^3), common profile-band covariance entries s_(N,k) bounded above and below, frequencies omega_(N,k)=Theta(N), and fixed relative excess C_(N,k)=r s_(N,k) with r>0.
shell_channel.channel: Independent coordinates M_(N,k)~N(0,r s_(N,k)), G_(N,k)~N(0,s_(N,k)), X_N=M_N+G_N form one common-floor continuous Gaussian location channel.
shell_channel.missing_fisher: Delta_N=[r/(1+r)]sum_(k in E_N)omega_(N,k)/s_(N,k)=Theta(N^4), so the K1606 one-quarter mixing term is Theta(N^4).
shell_channel.sharpness: The K1616 scales Delta_N<=2 Lambda_N I(M_N;X_N) are simultaneously attained up to constants on this shell family.
shell_channel.scope_guard: This is a method-sharpness witness. It does not prove that the full energy coefficient changes or that the missing-Fisher gain survives component and interaction costs.
